========================================
#if inside a method signature's selector list
========================================

@interface SUValidator : NSObject
- (instancetype)initWithEd:(NSString * _Nullable)ed
#if SPARKLE_BUILD_LEGACY_DSA_SUPPORT
                       dsa:(NSString * _Nullable)dsa
#endif
                       error:(NSError **)error;
@end
---

(translation_unit
  (class_interface
    (identifier)
    superclass: (identifier)
    (method_declaration
      (method_type
        (type_name
          (type_identifier)))
      (identifier)
      (method_parameter
        (method_type
          (type_name
            (type_identifier)
            (abstract_pointer_declarator
              (type_qualifier))))
        (identifier))
      (preproc_if
        condition: (identifier)
        (identifier)
        (method_parameter
          (method_type
            (type_name
              (type_identifier)
              (abstract_pointer_declarator
                (type_qualifier))))
          (identifier)))
      (identifier)
      (method_parameter
        (method_type
          (type_name
            (type_identifier)
            (abstract_pointer_declarator
              declarator: (abstract_pointer_declarator))))
        (identifier)))))
